meta.name: I Am Not Okay With This
meta.description:
Angsty Syd navigates high school awkwardness, family drama and an unrequited crush on her best friend while trying to rein in her budding superpowers.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Dear Diary...
videos.overview: When her best friend (and secret crush) hooks up with a crude jock, Syd seethes with anger ... and her feelings boil over in startling ways.

videos.title: The Master of One F**k
videos.overview: After Dina ditches her for Brad, Syd spends the afternoon with Stan — and learns there's more to him than she thought.

videos.title: The Party's Over
videos.overview: Memories of her dad send Syd to a dark place. At a party, Dina finds herself torn between Syd and Brad, and Stan asks Syd a question.

videos.title: Stan by Me
videos.overview: After fighting with her mom, Syd struggles to avoid a meltdown at school. Later, Stan appoints himself Syd's mentor.

videos.title: Another Day in Paradise
videos.overview: During a stint in detention, Brad offers Syd a truce, and an incident in the library leads to a high-stakes mission.

videos.title: Like Father, Like Daughter
videos.overview: Syd worries she's being followed. Anxious and determined to get closure about her father's death, she searches the basement for answers.

videos.title: Deepest, Darkest Secret
videos.overview: Armed with new insight about her dad, Syd vows to stay positive as she goes to the homecoming dance.
